hints.title: Can you keep a window?
hints.body: Suppose you have a window of characters that are all distinct. When you add the next character, what should happen if it is already inside the window?

hints.title: Remember the last position
hints.body: Store the most recent index of each character. When a repeat appears, the left edge of the window must move to one position after that previous index, but only if the previous index is still inside the window.

hints.title: One pass with two pointers
hints.body: Use a left pointer and a right pointer. For each right position, check the last-seen index of the character. If it is at or after the left pointer, move the left pointer past it. Update the character's last-seen index and the best length.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
last_seen = empty map
left = 0
best = 0
for right from 0 to length(text) - 1:
    char = text[right]
    if char is in last_seen and last_seen[char] >= left:
        left = last_seen[char] + 1
    last_seen[char] = right
    best = max(best, right - left + 1)
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Translate it into your language and check it against the examples.
